why: Palette step B (cmux#45625's 18 catalog rows): handlers for the rows of hand-built menus (downloads, back/forward entries, extension rows, update-card snooze, remote quality) and the menu routing that runs them. Each binding needs AppActionContext, BrowserDownloadList, BrowserPageRequests, the CEF extension store or the history page service, all App-only types, so no lower package can hold them; the rows, titles and arguments live in the Rust catalog. The new bindings sit in the existing toolbar, extension, remote and update handler files (no new App files or types).
